title: The specified strict four towers and their arrows
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring with adic coefficient datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, and $g':X'\to X$ form a chosen cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Write $\mathcal R_T$ for strict reduction, $L_u^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ for strict tower pullback, and $R_u^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ for strict tower direct image [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. For $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$, define
\[
 A_\bullet=L_g^{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_Y(Rf_*K),\quad
 B_\bullet=L_g^{\mathrm{Tow}}R_f^{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_X(K),\quad
 C_\bullet=\mathcal R_{Y'}(Rf'_*Lg'^*K),\quad
 D_\bullet=R_{f'}^{\mathrm{Tow}}L_{g'}^{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_X(K).
\]
Using the specified strict projection comparison $p_u$ and pullback/reduction isomorphism $\chi_u$, define $h=L_g^{\mathrm{Tow}}(p_f)$, $h'$ as $p_{f'}$ followed by $R_{f'}^{\mathrm{Tow}}(\chi_{g'}^{-1})$, $v=\chi_g$ followed by strict reduction of the integral exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange], and $v'=h^{-1}$ followed by $v$ and $h'$. The finite corner and arrow notation is [def-weil-pbc-four-corners, def-weil-pbc-four-arrows]. These are the existing strict constructions; no evaluation or rectangle assertion is included.
